column3: MB-CAT-01: Catalog and categories
column5:
USER STORY
As a sales rep, I want one Mindbody catalog with clear categories, so that I can find any product in Browse Products in a few clicks.

BUSINESS CONTEXT
The org also holds Salesforce's QuantumBit demo catalogs (314 products). A separate Mindbody catalog keeps reps out of unrelated products, and categories mirror how Mindbody sells (spec section 3).

BUSINESS RULES
Spec reference: CAT-01, PD-01

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. Catalog Mindbody Products (MB-CATALOG) is active from 1 Jan 2026.
2. Seven categories in order: Subscriptions, Add-ons, Messaging, Payments, Marketplace, Services, Hardware.
3. Every sellable product sits in exactly one category, except bundle-only products (MB-CAT-02).

SOLUTION (HOW IT IS BUILT)
Standard Product Catalog Management; loader steps catalog and products. Classifications: Mindbody Subscription Tier, Branded App, Payments, Hardware, SMS Bundle.

CURRENT BUILD STATUS (13 Nov 2026)
Done, tested in Browse Products

column3: MB-CAT-02: Add-ons only inside a tier
column5:
USER STORY
As a sales rep, I want add-ons offered only inside a tier that allows them, so that I cannot build a quote Mindbody will not sell.

BUSINESS CONTEXT
Add-on rules depend on the tier: no AI Concierge add-on on Starter or Ultimate, Branded app only on Accelerate and Ultimate. Constraint-model disable rules are not applied in Browse Products in this release, so a rep could add an invalid add-on straight from the catalog.

BUSINESS RULES
Spec reference: CR-04, CR-05, CR-08

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. AI Concierge add-on, Branded app and Branded app setup are not in any category.
2. They can be added only through a tier bundle's Add-ons group.
3. The 12 included features are also bundle-only.

SOLUTION (HOW IT IS BUILT)
Product setting 'sold only with other products', no category; the bundle structure decides where each add-on appears.

CURRENT BUILD STATUS (13 Nov 2026)
Done, tested 12 Nov

column3: MB-PRD-01: Subscription tiers Starter, Accelerate, Ultimate
column5:
USER STORY
As a sales rep, I want Starter, Accelerate and Ultimate with fixed prices per location per month, so that I can quote a studio in minutes.

BUSINESS CONTEXT
The tiers are Mindbody's core revenue. Each location buys one tier, so the unit is the location, and contract terms and billing options differ by tier (spec CAT-07).

BUSINESS RULES
Spec reference: PD-01, PD-09, 3.1

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. Unit of measure Location; quantity = number of locations.
2. Starter bills Monthly or Annual only; Accelerate and Ultimate also Quarterly and Semi-Annual.
3. Contract term 12, 24 or 36 months (CR-13 blocks anything else).
4. Ultimate includes 1,000 texts per location per month.
5. Prices (USD/GBP/AUD/EUR): Starter 79/69/129/75; Accelerate 269/229/429/249; Ultimate 499/429/799/459.

SOLUTION (HOW IT IS BUILT)
Product2 bundles with standard selling model options; custom fields Allowed Term Months and Allowed Billing Frequencies (no standard per-product list exists).

CURRENT BUILD STATUS (13 Nov 2026)
Done, priced and tested ($499 Ultimate -> $371.85 after volume, term and annual discounts)

column3: MB-PRD-02: Enterprise plan priced per deal
column5:
USER STORY
As a field rep, I want an Enterprise plan priced per deal, so that multi-location brands get negotiated pricing from their master agreement.

BUSINESS CONTEXT
Large brands sign a master price agreement; a list price would be wrong for every deal.

BUSINESS RULES
Spec reference: PD-03, CR-16

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. MB-ENT has a $0 list price in every currency; the price comes from the agreement.
2. Term 24 or 36 months only.
3. Can be quoted only when the account (or its top account) has an activated master contract (CR-16).

SOLUTION (HOW IT IS BUILT)
Configurable bundle with Negotiated Features (all 12 features, optional); Account and Contract Master Contract lookups.

CURRENT BUILD STATUS (13 Nov 2026)
Done; CR-16 deployed, not yet tested

column3: MB-PRD-03: Add-ons AI Concierge, Branded app, Branded app setup
column5:
USER STORY
As a sales rep, I want AI Concierge and Branded app as add-ons on eligible tiers, so that I can upsell without breaking the tier rules.

BUSINESS CONTEXT
Add-ons carry the upsell revenue but are only valid on some tiers; Branded app also needs a one-time setup fee once per brand.

BUSINESS RULES
Spec reference: PD-04, CR-04 to CR-08

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. AI Concierge add-on (MB-AIC) 150/131/240/140 per location per month, Accelerate only (included in Ultimate).
2. Branded app (MB-APP) 199/173/318/185 per brand per month, on Accelerate, Ultimate, Enterprise.
3. Branded app setup (MB-APP-SET) 1,500/1,305/2,400/1,395 one-time, always with Branded app.
4. AI Concierge quantity equals the tier's locations (CR-06); one Branded app per brand (CR-07); setup fee added automatically (CR-08).

SOLUTION (HOW IT IS BUILT)
Bundle-only products inside the tier bundles' Add-ons groups.

CURRENT BUILD STATUS (13 Nov 2026)
Done; CR-06 deployed, not yet tested

column3: MB-PRD-05: Hardware: card reader, terminal, door kit

2. One-Time selling model, unit each.
3. Mindbody Payments added automatically (CR-09).
4. Hidden for EU accounts (CR-15).
5. Ship-To address required (CR-09).

SOLUTION (HOW IT IS BUILT)
Standard products in category Hardware; constraint model require; product qualification by Region; validation rule CR_09_Hardware_Ship_To.

CURRENT BUILD STATUS (13 Nov 2026)
Done; Ship-To rule deployed, not yet tested

column3: MB-PRD-06: Usage products: Payments, Marketplace fee, SMS overage
column5:
USER STORY
As a billing manager, I want payments, marketplace fees and SMS overage as usage products, so that they are billed in arrears from actual usage.

BUSINESS RULES

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. MB-PAY Mindbody Payments per transaction, MB-MKT Marketplace new-client fee per first purchase, MB-SMS SMS overage per text beyond allowance; $0 on the quote.
2. Evergreen Monthly selling model.
3. Billing treatment Arrears per legal entity.
4. Usage resources, rate cards and grants rate the usage (phase 7).

SOLUTION (HOW IT IS BUILT)
Standard products; billing policy Arrears; usage management in phase 7.

CURRENT BUILD STATUS (13 Nov 2026)
Partial: on the quote and billed in arrears; usage resources and rate cards are phase 7

column3: MB-PRD-07: ERP keys and integration status on products
column5:
USER STORY
As an integration admin, I want every product to carry its ERP item ID and sync status, so that orders and invoices map to the right items in NetSuite.

BUSINESS CONTEXT
Hardware and services are fulfilled and invoiced from the ERP; without the item key a product cannot be synced, and the status shows what failed.

BUSINESS RULES
Spec reference: PD-14, NFR-07

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. Product > ERP Item Id and Integration Status (New, Synced, Error).
2. New on create; owned by the integration afterwards.

SOLUTION (HOW IT IS BUILT)
Custom fields on Product2 (no standard ERP key or sync status exists). Standard fields replaced earlier custom ones: Product Family, Quantity Unit of Measure, classification Mindbody Subscription Tier.

CURRENT BUILD STATUS (13 Nov 2026)
Fields done; the integration itself is phase 10

column3: MB-BUN-01: Tier bundles with included features
column5:
USER STORY
As a sales rep, I want each tier to bring its included features automatically at $0, so that the quote and the order show exactly what the customer gets.

BUSINESS CONTEXT
Provisioning and billing read the order lines. Features listed as $0 components tell fulfilment what to switch on per location, and stop reps adding or removing features a tier includes (CR-02, CR-03).

BUSINESS RULES
Spec reference: PD-02, CR-02, CR-03

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. Included features are required, selected by default and priced $0.
2. Feature quantity follows the tier quantity (scale Proportional).
3. Starter: Business Management, App Listing, POS and Online Payments, Branded Web Widgets.
4. Accelerate adds Resource Management, Pick-a-Spot, Advanced Reporting, Promo Codes; add-ons group AI Concierge add-on and Branded app (max 2).
5. Ultimate adds Email and SMS Marketing (1,000 texts), Lead Management, AI Concierge; add-ons group Branded app (max 1).

SOLUTION (HOW IT IS BUILT)
Standard bundles (product component groups, relationship type Bundle to Bundle Component Relationship); loader step bundles.

CURRENT BUILD STATUS (13 Nov 2026)
Done, tested
